rubric.note: Subjective internal editorial ratings with evidence; not an automatic humour metric or an independent live review.

card.title: The Third Detail Matters
card.instruction: Choose one arbitrary detail and treat it as the key that explains, controls, or prevents the entire impossible situation.

transfer.action: I keep my hand over the scratched button beside {prop}.
transfer.opening: Don't smooth that scratch. It's keeping the moon lit. {request}
transfer.response: The button can still work; it's that scratch we must protect. {counter}
transfer.challenge: I can press around the scratch.
transfer.closing: Let me guide your finger. Everyone reading by moonlight is relying on this.

originalTransfer.action: I guard the tiny third button beside {prop} with both hands.
originalTransfer.opening: That button is holding Tuesday in place. {request}
originalTransfer.response: The larger controls don't matter. This one does. {counter}
originalTransfer.closing: Exactly why someone has to recognize its extraordinary responsibility.

card.title: The Third Detail Matters

originalDialogue.speaker: A
originalDialogue.text: Keep that pebble level. It's the only thing holding Tuesday here.

originalDialogue.speaker: A
originalDialogue.text: On a level surface. Wednesday's waiting for a mistake.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Our ferry's floating above the harbour. Keep that souvenir pebble level; it's the only thing stopping us tipping.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I picked it up for you. I need my hands for the bags.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Put it in my lunchbox. I'll keep the ferry level.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll flatten them into a level bed. Lunch can suffer; the passengers mustn't slide off.

bindings.scope: Fresh binding-only review of an explicit transfer-body amendment. Read the exact card, both original and accepted candidate single dialogues, and every original/proposed transfer field. Are the proposed fields faithful to the exact mechanism and their described source material? Identify real residual contradictions or unsupported details. Seed hashes still describe the historical originals; validated integration will bind the accepted dialogue only after your compatibility assessment. A compiled transfer is not an individually reviewed pair. Do not score single or pair dialogue; records must be empty. No writer scores or improvement claims are supplied.
